# Getting help

**Something is broken.** Open an issue and choose the bug report template:
[report a bug](https://github.com/makingaipractical/claude-code-fuel-gauge/issues/new/choose).
The template asks you to paste the output of the **Claude Code Fuel Gauge: Show Diagnostics**
command. That output answers most of the questions I would otherwise have to ask you.

**You have a question.** Ask it in
[Discussions, under Q&A](https://github.com/makingaipractical/claude-code-fuel-gauge/discussions/categories/q-a).

**You have an idea.** Post it in
[Discussions, under Ideas](https://github.com/makingaipractical/claude-code-fuel-gauge/discussions/categories/ideas).

**You want to reach me directly.** For anything that does not belong on a public
tracker — including work enquiries — email
[info@makingaipractical.com](mailto:info@makingaipractical.com).

**You found a security problem.** Please do not open a public issue. Read
[SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md) for how to report it privately.
